title: 9 Things a Godly Man Does on the Drive Home for Christmas
caption:
Most of us spend the drive home for Christmas half on the road and half on the phone.

But those hours are a gift. No one can reach you if you don't let them. That's room for God before you walk into a house full of people.

Put the phone face down. Sit in silence for twenty minutes. Listen to a whole Gospel. Pray for everyone at the other end by name. Decide at mile fifty what old habit isn't coming in the door with you.

Then text one brother when you pull in.

Save this for the drive. Send it to the brother who's heading home too.
